name: BAS dbsim marker in database audit event
description: Lab detection rule for the Audspect dbsim simulation. Alerts when a PostgreSQL or MySQL audit/general-log event carries the bas-dbsim: probe marker. The alert keeps the original audit message (message, event.original) and the DB server host.name / host.ip so the orchestrator can post-filter by marker.
query: message : "bas-dbsim:" and not message : ("dbsim-meta" or "general_log" or "pg_log" or "dbsim_audit" or "events_statements_history_long")
author: Audspect
